extracted.name: Garden Salad
extracted.description: My old school Garden Salad. The one I can make any day because I always have these vegetables on hand! And sometimes, when I feel like getting really fancy, I even add a sprinkle of parsley. 😳There really are no rules when it comes to a Garden Salad. Any greens, any vegetables. Make this your own!
ingredient_lines: 1 small head iceberg lettuce or other lettuce or leafy greens (, chopped into big bite size pieces (5 to 6 big handfuls))
1 cup cherry or grape tomatoes, halved ((~125g/4oz), or 2 tomatoes cut into wedges or chunks)
1 cucumber (, sliced (medium Lebanese / Persian cucumber, or 1/2 long Telegraph/English cucumber))
1 carrot (, peeled and grated using a box grater)
1 tsp parsley or chives (, very finely chopped (if you're feeling fancy!))
1 tbsp cider vinegar ((or any vinegar or lemon juice) (Note 1))
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil ((or other neutral oil))
1/2 tsp Dijon Mustard ((or other non spicy smooth mustard))
1/2 tsp cooking/kosher salt ((or 1/4 tsp table salt))
instruction_lines: Dressing: Shake Dressing in a jar. Taste and adjust - more oil for creamier/less tang, vinegar for more tang, sugar if you want touch of sweet.
Toss: Place all Salad ingredients in a big bowl. Pour over Dressing. Toss well.
Serve: Transfer to serving bowl and serve immediately!
